steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each clause is placed by whether its evidence is present, partial or absent.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Clause absent with no record
findings.fix: Write the record the clause needs

outcome.notChecked: Whether the evidence is true; the certification body's view.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] clause-7-support.md:12  Clause absent with no record.
       Fix: Write the record the clause needs.
[medium] clause-5-leadership.md:19  Clause partly evidenced.
       Fix: Add the missing record.
[low] clause-9-evaluation.md:26  Evidence not dated.
       Fix: Date the record.
Not checked: Whether the evidence is true; the certification body's view.
pros: Checks an absent or partial clause with the record it would need.
cons: Not checked: Whether the evidence is true; the certification body's view.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ind-audit-readiness skill on the records for this review.
